title: DeepEvo yields heat-tolerant G3PDH variants
summary: A generative model and protein-language-model-based temperature selector were combined in an iterative design procedure. The article reports eight heat-tolerant glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase variants among 30 generated and tested sequences. This is an experimentally screened enzyme set, not proof of industrial deployment.
ai_technology: DeepEvo generative model; protein language model temperature selector
organization: Tianjin Institute of Industrial Biotechnology, Chinese Academy of Sciences

evidence.tested: Publisher article reports eight heat-tolerant variants among 30 generated sequences tested.
evidence.unknown: Exact assay definition, earlier disclosure and sequence-level prior overlap remain open.
evidence.ai_role: Generative model proposes functional sequences and PLM-based selector ranks high-temperature candidates in iterative design/test loop.

source_review.scope: Primary source checked for identity, date, model role and bounded reported result.
